hook_plan.narration: Warning! New tariffs just dropped, threatening the entire semiconductor boom!
hook_plan.image_description: A digital grid forming a barrier, with glitch effects and pulsing red warning lights. A cybernetic eye reflects complex data streams related to global trade, showing intense focus.

thumbnail_plan.image_description: 3D render of a highly detailed, glowing microchip at the center, surrounded by abstract, intertwining metallic lines representing global supply chains. Dramatic backlighting, 8k resolution, cyberpunk aesthetic.
thumbnail_plan.reasoning: The image is object-centric and visually striking, implying geopolitical tension and market disruption without being overtly negative, appealing to investors and industry insiders with its mystery and scale.

title: Chip Tariffs & AI: The $1.6 Trillion Semiconductor Crossroads

segments.text: Global chip sales are projected to reach $1.6 trillion by 2030, maintaining a 15% CAGR. This exponential growth is driven by insatiable AI demand and critical data center CAPEX.
segments.image_prompt: Holographic projection of a rapidly rising market graph over a futuristic cityscape at night. Neon blue and green data streams. Intense focus through smart glasses reflecting the growth.

segments.text: Unprecedented CAPEX in HBM and GPU fabrication validates this surge. Industry giants like NVIDIA and TSMC are pushing design limits, meeting AI's intense compute requirements.
segments.image_prompt: Extreme close-up of HBM memory stacks on a silicon wafer, intricate circuitry glowing with internal light. Data streams flow across the surface like liquid metal.

segments.text: Beyond core AI, the Image Signal Processors market will hit $4.62 billion by 2026. Sony, Samsung, and Qualcomm lead in next-gen automotive and mobile applications.
segments.image_prompt: Digital render of an autonomous car's sensor array, focusing on a smart camera lens with a glowing iris reflecting data. Overlayed data streams highlight market projections.

segments.text: Crucially, a 'Build in America or Pay' tariff phase is confirmed. This Lutnick-announced policy directly impacts global wafer manufacturing, forcing strategic re-evaluations.
segments.image_prompt: Stylized, glowing outline of a semiconductor factory with a transparent American flag overlaid. Digital corruption effects and pulsing red warning lights around it.

segments.text: The implications for future CAPEX and global supply chains are significant.
segments.image_prompt: A complex, glowing circuit board design intricately layered onto a holographic globe, highlighting key manufacturing regions with analytical data points. No human element, purely abstract data visualization.
